The Hyundai GV60 is an all-electric passenger vehicle, so it falls under heading 8703. Subheading 8703.80 covers other vehicles with only an electric motor for propulsion. The 10-digit statistical suffix is the part I'm least sure of. I recall 8703.80.0100 as "Other vehicles, with only electric motor for propulsion" and 8703.80.0000 as an older code. The current HTSUS (2022 onward) has 8703.80.10 for vehicles with only an electric motor for propulsion, with 8703.80.1000 as the code, and 8703.80.50 for other. The earlier structure was 8703.80.00 with 8703.80.0100 as "Electric motor only." I'm not certain which applies, so I'm going with the current structure.

Current structure as I recall it: 8703.80.10 is "Motor vehicles with only electric motor for propulsion: Other" (e.g., 8703.80.1000?), and 8703.80.50 is the remaining electric-only category. I'll go with 8703.80.1000.
